definitions.E_aggregation: Unweighted means/ranges of independent preparation-level quantities; pooled ratio also reported; no confidence claims
definitions.averaged_conditional_F: Take F of the graph-weighted mean target trace-distance matrix; differs from average graph-conditioned F
definitions.connectivity: Reported mass, never a selection filter; disconnected graphs can have a high conditioned F
definitions.graph_conditioned_F: Compute F separately within each known graph, then average over valid graphs; validity mass reported
definitions.limits: Graph-adapted target choice is a different conditional protocol from the primary unconditioned labeled assay; these are supplied static controls
definitions.partial_zero_source: At least one but not every source row has zero response; whole-graph F remains undefined
definitions.unobserved_mixture_F: Average target density matrices first, then take target trace distances and F
definitions.valid_graph_F: Every source has nonzero total off-diagonal response above1e-10; undefined source rows are not omitted
definitions.zero_total_response: All source rows have total off-diagonal response at most1e-10

protocol: Age2 Born law or exact density/degree null; fresh tilted matter; frozen graph TFIM h=g=1; Pauli-Y probe
status: SECONDARY DESCRIPTIVE; does not alter the registered decision
